rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, noting compact ICM and cohesive TE, but it shows uncertainty/confusion about stage 3 vs 4 and includes some speculative features from a single image.
Integrates age, AMH, BMI, tubal factor, endometrium, smoking, prior IVF history, and semen parameters well, though hydrosalpinx is discussed as a major caveat without confirmation in the case data.

Overall logic is reasonable, but there are internal inconsistencies around blastocyst staging, repeated hedging, and some probability statements that mix implantation, live birth, and euploid-specific outcomes.

Mostly evidence-based on smoking cessation, hydrosalpinx management, and avoiding unsupported adjuvants, but routine suggestion of PGT-A in this first-cycle 34-year-old is not strongly guideline-based and staging comments are somewhat off Gardner conventions.
Provides practical next steps for transfer support, lifestyle modification, hydrosalpinx evaluation, and future-cycle considerations, though some recommendations remain somewhat generic.
